title: dictyBase 2026: a reimplementation of the Dictyostelium model organism database on minimal infrastructure.
authors: Mendieta, Maddox; Dodson, Robert J; Basu, Siddhartha; Chisholm, Rex L; Scaglione, K
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍Dictyostelium模式生物数据库dictyBase的重实现，虽包含蛋白结构信息但以数据管理和文献注释为主，缺乏蛋白质结构计算建模或AI/物理模拟方法贡献，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Dictyostelium discoideum is a model organism used to investigate a wide array of biological processes including chemotaxis, cell motility, phagocytosis, multicellular development, and autophagy. Many of its genes have human orthologs implicated in disease, making it a useful model organism for studying conditions ranging from cancer to neurodegeneration. dictyBase has served this community for two decades as a home for genomic data, protocols, a stock center, and community news. Here we describe a complete reimplementation of dictyBase as a self-contained service that uses static data files rather than a database server. Each gene record gathers curated function, human-disease context, developmental expression, and protein structure in a single webpage. The site also provides tools for sequence search, genome browsing, enrichment analysis, and experimental design. The complete Dicty Stock Center (DSC) catalog of 7,055 strains and 1,265 plasmids is included, and both can be ordered from the site. New literature is curated by an author-in-the-loop pipeline. A language model drafts the annotations, the authors of the paper correct them, and a curator approves them. Analyses can be run on curator-approved annotations alone or extended to include those still awaiting review. dictyBase is freely available at https://dicty.org.
abstract_zh: 盘基网柄菌（Dictyostelium discoideum）是一种模式生物，用于研究多种生物过程，包括趋化性、细胞运动、吞噬作用、多细胞发育和自噬。其许多基因具有与人类疾病相关的人类同源基因，使其成为研究从癌症到神经退行性疾病等多种病症的有用模式生物。dictyBase 二十年来一直为该社区服务，作为基因组数据、实验方案、菌株中心和社区新闻的基地。在此，我们描述了 dictyBase 的完全重新实现，作为一个自包含服务，使用静态数据文件而非数据库服务器。每个基因记录在单个网页中汇集了精选功能、人类疾病背景、发育表达和蛋白质结构。该网站还提供序列搜索、基因组浏览、富集分析和实验设计工具。完整的 Dicty 菌株中心（DSC）目录包含 7,055 株菌株和 1,265 个质粒，均可从该网站订购。新文献通过作者参与流程进行精选。语言模型起草注释，论文作者进行修正，策展人批准。分析可仅基于策展人批准的注释运行，或扩展至包括待审注释。dictyBase 可在 https://dicty.org 免费获取。
